collection.title: Bentley Flying Spur 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Bentley Flying Spur 2019 onwards  model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
